strings.subtitle: — Nongpynjot fail —
strings.no_file: Ym don fail ba la jied
strings.dnd_hint: (lane wallam fail ha kane ka windo)
strings.dnd_unavailable: Ka jinglane bad jingpyndep ym don. Pyndonkam ia ka button hapoh.
strings.info_title: JINGTHUP KI JINGTIP ÏA KA FAIL
strings.shred_button: P Y N J O T
strings.ssd_warning:
Mahap! Ha SSD, ka buit ban thoh halor kam jamin pynjot namar TRIM.
Kane ka program ka long na ka bynta HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Yn thoh halor ia ka fail "{name}" bad yn sahkñia.

Leh noh?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
Kane ka long ka shortcut (.lnk). Tang ka shortcut hi kin jin dañ.

Ka file ba ka ïarap shaphang kin sah bad ka jingïaishah.

Ïaid shwa?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
Kane ka long ka network drive (\\server\share).
Ka jingthoh halor ki sector kam ai jingkular ia ka jingjin dañ — ka server ka lah ban don ki snapshot, deduplication ne CoW.

Ïaid shwa?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
Kane ka long ka drive ba lah ban noh (USB / HDD shabar).
Ka controller ka lah ban bishar ia ki block ba la dep.

Ïaid shwa?
strings.error_file_not_found: Ym shym la shem ia ka fail.
strings.error_cannot_read:
Ym lah ban pule ia ka fail:
{err}
strings.report_title: ✅  LA THOH HALOR IA KA FAIL BAD LA SAHKÑIA
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS jingthup datawei kiwei (ADS) kim shym la leh.
• USN journal ym shym la pyntip.
• Shadow copy bad cloud sync
  (OneDrive bad kiwei) kim shym la ktah.
strings.step_delete: Sahkñia da ban kyntait ïa ka basket
strings.status_full: La thoh halor baroh da zero. Ym lah ban pynphai — ki tiar kin ïohi tang zero.
strings.status_fast: La thoh halor ïa ka khlieh, ka tdong bad ki patti 4 MB. Ka bynta ba don kam shym la ktah, hynrei namar ki jaka ba thylli, ka jingpynphai pura da ki tiar jong ki nongthoh kim lah. Na ka bynta ki kot bah, pyndonkam ia ka mode KYNDON.
strings.status_empty: Ka fail ka long lehpuid, ym dei ban thoh halor. La sahkñia.
strings.error_permission: Ym lah ban leit sha ka file. Ka lah ban long ba la plie ha kawei pat ka program. Pyllait bad kyrpa biang.
strings.error_not_found: Ym lah ban shem ia ka file. Ka lah ban long ba la pynshat lypa.
strings.error_is_symlink: Kane ka long ka symbolic link. Ym lah ban pynshat ia ki link — ka file ba la thmu kin sah bad ka jingïaishah.
strings.error_reparse: Kane ka long ka placeholder file (OneDrive ne kaba ïasyriem). Ki data jong ka ki don ha ka cloud, ym ha ka disk — ym don kaba pynshat hangne.
strings.error_not_file: Kane kam long ka file (folder ne kabawei pat). Ryntih ia ka file.
strings.error_hardlinks: Kane ka file ka don kiwei pat ki hard link ({n} baroh). Ki hard link kim don ka ba nyngkong — baroh ki kyrteng ki ïasyriem. Lada phi pynshat lyngba ka lynti ba mynta, kin thoh halor ia ki data bad kin ot sha 32 bytes, hynrei ka stub kin sah ban ïoh leit lyngba kiwei pat ki link. Pynshat baroh ki link shuwa.
strings.error_compressed:
Ka file ka la kynthup, la pynskhem ne la pynïapher. Ka jingthoh ziro kam ai jingkular ia ka jingjin dañ jong ki data ba la dep namar NTFS ka bishar ïa ki ha ka rukom ba pher.

Noh ia ka attribute: pyllait kti kamon → Ki Jinglong → Ba kham por → pynïapher 'Compress' bad/ne 'Encrypt'. Nangta sdang SHREDDER biang.
strings.queue_hint: (ne wat sngewbha ryntih ia ki file ha kane ka windo)
strings.queue_progress_total: Ka jrong baroh jong ka jingïaid: {current} na {total}
strings.queue_stopping: ⏹ Nga ap hadien ka file ba mynta...
strings.queue_confirm_text:
{count} ki file kin jin dañ.
Ka jrong baroh: {size}.

Peit ia ka list shuwa ban ïaid shwa.
Kane ka kam kam long ban pynthymmai.
strings.queue_clear_confirm_text:
Noh ia ki {count} file na ka queue?

Ki file hi KIN ÏA KTOH — tang ka list.
strings.hardlink_title: ⚠ KA JINGÏAID JONG KA HARD LINK
strings.hardlink_text:
Ka file "{name}" ka don kiwei pat ki hard link ({nlink} baroh).

Ki data kin jin dañ na ka bynta baroh ki kyrteng.
Hynrei ki jingïaid (32 bytes) kin sah hapoh kiwei pat ki kyrteng ha ka folder.

Phi lah ban donkam ban pynshat ia kine ki jingïaid da kti.
strings.hardlink_apply_all: Pyndonkam ha baroh ki hard link ha ka queue
strings.queue_reason_cannot_read: ym lah ban pule ia ka jrong baroh
